2026.07.11.4.title: Paper Organizer, Link Batches, and Library Search
2026.07.11.4.summary: Renames the canonical paper workflow to paper-organizer, adds safe offline link ingestion and parallel mixed-link batches, reorganizes user guides, and expands Paper Finder across every Markdown note associated with a paper.
2026.07.11.4.how_to_apply: Update the managed skills, scripts, tests, prompts, and documentation together. Use paper-organizer for new PDF and link tasks; paper-summarizer remains a compatibility alias. Preprocess public links into local source_context.txt files before external-engine calls. No configuration or paper-library migration is required.
added: paper-organizer canonical skill and scripts.paper_organizer entrypoint with paper-summarizer compatibility routers.

Safe public-link preprocessing through landing-page metadata, arXiv, Crossref, OpenAlex, and Unpaywall, producing local source_context.txt files without authentication, browser sessions, or paywall bypassing.
Dedicated link-metadata generation for existing YAML fields, the paper-title heading, and the public abstract without interpretive sections or ai_summary.md.
Managed parallel pure-link generation for OpenRouter, Agy CLI, and Codex CLI with four workers by default and a configurable 1-8 limit.
Public-PDF routes for pending mode, metadata-only, and full summary, plus structured authoritative citation sidecars, batch deduplication, and existing-library checks.
Recursive visible-Markdown discovery inside valid paper folders, including legacy summary.md and future nested notes.
Structured matched-note paths, terms, counts, and bounded excerpts in human and JSON search results.
Full matched-note context with a 60,000-character per-paper default and an explicit unbounded option.
README and quick-start guidance for vault placement, PDF and link entry points, Markdown link inboxes, mixed batches, copyright awareness, and valid paper folders with or without PDFs.
changed: External link engines receive prepared text only: OpenRouter receives no tools, Codex web search stays disabled, and Agy is instructed not to browse.
Public Google Drive PDFs can be retained through unauthenticated downloads without sending PDF text to link-metadata engines.
Coding-Agent Additions and structured citation sidecars override weaker engine metadata; bare DOI links and canonical landing URLs participate in duplicate detection.
Mixed batches split pure links from public-PDF metadata/full groups, finalize folder writes sequentially, retain failed diagnostics, and report partial failures in input order.
OpenRouter PDF batches accept --max-workers, while Agy and Codex managed calls use isolated per-run inputs and diagnostics.
Paper folders and validation allow link-only records without a PDF, and cross-skill handoffs and onboarding use paper-organizer as the canonical name.
Skill guides now live under quick_start/skills, Obsidian guidance lives under quick_start/obsidian, and all README and use-case links point to the categorized paths.
Additional note matches contribute through one capped paper-level scoring field so repeated files cannot create independent field bonuses.
Normal Paper Finder results separately expose trimmed metadata, AI-summary context, and matched additional-note evidence.
Term occurrence counting now preserves repetitions so the documented logarithmic field caps operate correctly.
removed: The obsolete duplicated paper-summarizer quick-start guide; the thin compatibility guide remains under quick_start/skills.

2026.07.06.1.title: Out-of-vault Git Versioning
2026.07.06.1.summary: Moves git versioning out of the (iCloud-synced) library folder into a separate git backup repo, so a live .git no longer risks iCloud corruption. Adds a versioning-with-git skill, a config.json git block, and matching onboarding.
2026.07.06.1.how_to_apply: Config shape changed: git settings moved from top-level use_git into a git block { use_git, sync_to_remote, backup_abs_path } and schema_version is now 2. config.py reads the git block with a legacy fallback to top-level use_git, so existing configs keep working with no change. To enable out-of-vault versioning, set git.backup_abs_path to a plain local folder OUTSIDE iCloud (re-run onboarding or edit config.json); commits then mirror the library into that repo instead of committing in place. Remove any .git left inside the library folder once the backup repo holds the current state.
added: versioning-with-git skill: mirrors the library into an out-of-iCloud git backup repo, commits all changes there, and optionally pulls/pushes a remote.
config.json git block: use_git, sync_to_remote, backup_abs_path (with PAPERHUB_SYNC_TO_REMOTE_GIT and PAPERHUB_GIT_BACKUP env overrides).
Onboarding questionnaire git section (3 settings) plus iCloud 'Keep Downloaded' guidance and the rule that the backup folder must live outside iCloud.
changed: paper-summarizer post-AI, tag, and enrich flows now commit via the versioning-with-git skill instead of running git inside the library folder.
config schema_version bumped to 2; use_git relocated under the git block (legacy top-level use_git still honored).
onboard.md git logic no longer runs git init in the vault; it configures the backup repo and removes any in-vault .git.

2026.07.06.2.title: Vault Knowledge Base Search
2026.07.06.2.summary: Adds ask-knowledge-base for answering questions from visible Obsidian Markdown notes, backed by a local vault search script, optional non-paper-note mode, and skill-specific quick-start docs.
2026.07.06.2.how_to_apply: Safe skill, script, test, and docs updates can be applied directly. The new search uses obsidian.vault_abs_path from config.json when valid and otherwise falls back to the PaperHub root; no migration is required. Use --ignore-papers only when you want to search vault notes while skipping generated PaperHub paper metadata and summaries.
added: ask-knowledge-base skill for question answering across visible vault Markdown with Obsidian wikilink citations.
knowledge_base_search.py utility script with top/detail limits, exclude penalties, JSON output, bounded full-context mode, and optional --ignore-papers filtering.
Skill-specific quick-start docs for paper-summarizer, paper-finder, ask-knowledge-base, and update-paperhub-utils.
changed: README and quick-start docs now describe ask-knowledge-base below paper-finder without promoting immature downloader workflows.

ask-knowledge-base can now honor explicit non-paper-note requests by skipping standard PaperHub metadata notes plus ai_summary.md and legacy summary.md generated summaries while keeping hand-written Markdown notes searchable.
public-template-sync is protected as maintainer-only in both .claude and .agents skill paths.
